items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: And eventually he got busy with his radio work, he went to Pittsburgh and I took it over and kind of led it.

ctx.x: Tell me about how The Nighthawks came about.

Well I was in Italy playing with a little jazz band over there and I got a postcard from a friend of mine and he says, “you better get back to the States because there’s a fellow here, a radio DJ by the name of Rich Connerty, who’s putting together a band to play old Paul Whiteman arrangements.” So I said wow that’s pretty interesting. So I get back to the States after the gig is over, and I look him up, and sure enough he got Xeroxes from Williams College collection of the Paul Whiteman scores and just announced…
And that evolved into a group that you could gig with?
